title: CRYING IN THE CHAPEL
lyrics_synced:
[00:09.66] You saw me crying in the chapel
[00:15.28] The tears I shed were tears of joy
[00:21.26] I know the meaning of contentment
[00:27.10] Now I am happy with the Lord
[00:33.33] Just a plain and simple chapel
[00:38.98] Where all good people go to pray
[00:44.97] I prayed the Lord that I'll grow stronger
[00:51.11] As I live from day to day
[00:59.01] I searched and I searched but I couldn't find
[01:04.91] No way on earth to find peace of mind
[01:08.89] Now I'm happy in the chapel
[01:14.78] Where people are of one accord
[01:20.71] Yes, we gather in the chapel
[01:26.63] Just to sing and praise the Lord
[01:32.62] Take your troubles to the chapel
[01:38.53] Get down on your knees and pray
[01:44.41] Then your burdens will be lighter
[01:50.34] And you'll surely find a way
[01:58.25] You'll search and you'll search but you'll never find
[02:04.09] No way on earth to find peace of mind
[02:08.08] Take your troubles to the chapel
[02:14.08] Get down on your knees and pray
[02:20.00] Then your burdens will be lighter
[02:25.96] And you'll surely find a way
